          const chosen=entries.reduce((best,item)=>{const a=new Date(`${item[1][boundary]}T00:00:00`).getTime(),b=new Date(`${best[1][boundary]}T00:00:00`).getTime();return boundary==='start'?(a>b?item:best):(a<b?item:best);},entries[0]);
          const [ticker,cov]=chosen;
          const note=document.createElement('div'); note.className='feedback-note period-constraint-note';
          note.innerHTML=`<strong>Note:</strong> The time period was constrained by the available data for ${esc(cov.name||assetName(ticker))} (${esc(ticker)}) [${esc(monthYear(cov.start))} - ${esc(monthYear(cov.end))}].`;
          overview.appendChild(note);
        }
      }
    }

    // 2. Replace CSS donuts with SVG slices so the chart itself can expose ticker/allocation on hover.
    const polar=(cx,cy,r,angle)=>{const rad=(angle-90)*Math.PI/180;return {x:cx+r*Math.cos(rad),y:cy+r*Math.sin(rad)}};
    const donutPath=(cx,cy,rOuter,rInner,start,end)=>{const a=polar(cx,cy,rOuter,end),b=polar(cx,cy,rOuter,start),c=polar(cx,cy,rInner,start),d=polar(cx,cy,rInner,end),large=end-start>180?1:0;return `M ${a.x} ${a.y} A ${rOuter} ${rOuter} 0 ${large} 0 ${b.x} ${b.y} L ${c.x} ${c.y} A ${rInner} ${rInner} 0 ${large} 1 ${d.x} ${d.y} Z`;};
    const interactiveDonut=(id,key)=>{
      const root=section(id); if(!root)return; const holder=root.querySelector('.allocation-donut'); if(!holder)return;
      const rows=optRows.filter(r=>finite(r[key])&&Number(r[key])>0.00005); if(!rows.length)return;
      const svg=svgEl('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 200 200',class:'allocation-svg'}); let angle=0;
      rows.forEach(row=>{const value=Number(row[key]), next=angle+value*3.6, path=svgEl('path',{d:donutPath(100,100,92,51,angle,next),fill:assetColor(row.ticker)}); path.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>showTip(e,`<b>${esc(assetName(row.ticker))} (${esc(row.ticker)})</b><br>Allocation: ${pct(value)}`)); path.addEventListener('mouseleave',hideTip); svg.appendChild(path); angle=next;});
      holder.replaceWith(svg);
    };
    interactiveDonut('provided-portfolio','provided_weight_pct'); interactiveDonut('optimized-portfolio','optimized_weight_pct');

    // Shared grouped tooltip for all bars belonging to the same year.
    const groupedYearHover=(id,rows,series)=>{
      const root=chart(id), svg=root?.querySelector('svg'); if(!svg||!rows.length)return; svg.querySelectorAll('.year-hit').forEach(n=>n.remove());
      const width=1000,left=58,right=24,group=(width-left-right)/rows.length;
      rows.forEach((row,i)=>{const hit=svgEl('rect',{x:left+i*group,y:10,width:group,height:245,fill:'transparent',class:'year-hit','pointer-events':'all'}); hit.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>showTip(e,`<b>${esc(row.year)}</b><br>${series.filter(s=>finite(row[s.key])).map(s=>`<span style="color:${s.color}">●</span> ${esc(s.label)}: ${pct(row[s.key])}`).join('<br>')}`)); hit.addEventListener('mouseleave',hideTip); svg.appendChild(hit);});
    };
    groupedYearHover('annual-returns',data.annual_returns||[],[
      {key:'provided_return_pct',label:'Provided Annual Return',color:BLUE},{key:'optimized_return_pct',label:'Optimized Annual Return',color:PURPLE},{key:'benchmark_return_pct',label:`${benchmarkLabel} Annual Return`,color:GRAY}
    ]);
    groupedYearHover('annualized-active-return',data.annualized_active_returns||[],[
      {key:'provided_active_return_pct',label:'Provided Active Return',color:BLUE},{key:'optimized_active_return_pct',label:'Optimized Active Return',color:PURPLE}
    ]);
    groupedYearHover('annual-asset-returns',(data.annual_asset_returns||[]).map(p=>({year:p.year,...(p.returns_pct||{})})),[...assetByTicker.keys()].map(t=>({key:t,label:`${assetName(t)} (${t})`,color:assetColor(t)})));

    const renderTable=(id,rows,cols,note='')=>{const slot=tableSlot(id);if(!slot)return;if(!rows.length){slot.innerHTML='<div class="empty">N/A</div>';return;}slot.innerHTML=`<table class="feedback-table"><thead><tr>${cols.map(c=>`<th>${esc(c.label)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(r=>`<tr>${cols.map(c=>{const v=typeof c.value==='function'?c.value(r):r[c.key];return `<td>${c.format?c.format(v,r):esc(v??'')}</td>`}).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>${note?`<div class="feedback-table-note">${note}</div>`:''}`;};

    // 4. Efficient Frontier Assets: Name first, then ticker.
    const frontierAssets=(data.frontier_assets||[]).map(a=>({...a,name:a.name||assetName(a.symbol),sharpe_ratio:finite(a.sharpe_ratio)?a.sharpe_ratio:(finite(effectiveRfPct)&&finite(a.standard_deviation_pct)?(Number(a.expected_return_pct)-effectiveRfPct)/Number(a.standard_deviation_pct):null)}));
    renderTable('efficient-frontier-assets',frontierAssets,[
